title: Salmon or oily fish
why: Omega-3 fats support heart and vascular health

title: Lean poultry
why: Quality protein supports muscle and recovery

title: Eggs
why: Protein and micronutrients for sustained energy

title: Curd (dahi)
why: Protein and probiotics for gut health — a staple in Indian meals
portion: 1 katori (about 150 ml) plain curd; skip heavily sweetened lassi

title: Oats and whole grains
why: Steady energy and fiber for digestion
portion: ½–1 cup cooked oats or brown rice

title: Berries
why: Antioxidants with lower sugar impact than sweets
portion: 1 cup as snack or with breakfast

title: Nuts (almonds, walnuts)
why: Healthy fats and protein in small amounts

title: Sugary drinks
why: Blood sugar spikes and empty calories
portion: Replace with water or unsweetened tea

title: Heavy alcohol
why: Can reduce sleep quality and performance

title: Fried fast food
why: High saturated fat may affect energy and weight
portion: Choose grilled or baked options instead

title: Large late-night meals
portion: Finish larger meals 3 hours before bed
